about: The first bytes of a /update upload: what core::checkUpdateImageHead (src/core/firmware.h) and the simulator's copy (test/e2e/device-sim.mjs) answer, word for word (plan 1.9.1 E4, review 8 R5-7). Each case is a file of len bytes, 0 except the bytes in set (offset -> value), offered to a board of chip; want is the refusal, or null for an image the board takes. Read by test/native/tests.cpp and test/e2e/run.mjs.

cases.name: ESP32 app image on an ESP32
ESP32-S3 app image on an ESP32-S3
a longer ESP32 image (the whole file is offered)
ESP32-S3 image on an ESP32
cases.want: This image is for another chip, not the ESP32 (WROOM)

cases.name: ESP32 image on an ESP32-S3
cases.want: This image is for another chip, not the ESP32-S3

cases.name: ESP32-S3 full-flash image (bootloader at 0x0: 0xE9, no app magic)
cases.want: Not a firmware update image: it starts with a bootloader (a -full-flash image). Use ironframe-rfid-<version>.bin

cases.name: ESP32 full-flash image (bootloader at 0x1000: 0xFF first)
cases.want: Not a firmware update image (it does not start with 0xE9). A -full-flash image is for a serial flash only: use ironframe-rfid-<version>.bin

cases.name: a file that is not an image
cases.want: Not a firmware update image (it does not start with 0xE9). A -full-flash image is for a serial flash only: use ironframe-rfid-<version>.bin

cases.name: 35 bytes
cases.want: The file is too short to be a firmware image

cases.name: empty
cases.want: The file is too short to be a firmware image

cases.name: chip id high byte set
cases.want: This image is for another chip, not the ESP32 (WROOM)
